G1-network.detail: P2AllyAC.forward(obs, mask) returns (logits[B,19], value[B,1]); mask applies -inf to illegal actions; trunk inherits P2AllyPolicyNet; BC heads preserved via forward_bc

G2-bc-load.detail: load_bc_checkpoint_into_ac copies trunk + 4 BC heads from BC checkpoint; action/value heads remain at their current (random/RL-trained) init; mismatched hidden_dim raises ValueError

G3-gae.detail: GAE lambda=0,0.95,1.0 verified against manual computation; default normalize=True yields zero mean + unit std

G4-ppo-converge.detail: 100-step training loop runs with finite losses; 50-rollout × 1-step training on 2-action toy backend increases action_a picks from random baseline to >50% of 20 evaluation episodes

G5-checkpoint.detail: save_rl_checkpoint/load_rl_checkpoint roundtrip preserves forward outputs exactly; payload includes schema, policy_config, num_actions, state_dict with trunk+heads+action_head+value_head

G6-rollout-integration.detail: collect_rollout(env, policy, n_steps) returns buffer with N entries; auto-reset on terminal; deterministic mode reproducible; end-to-end rollout→PPOTrainer.train returns finite metrics
